name: chinese-classics-reader
description: 中国古典文学阅读站：唐诗、宋词、世说新语与大学，共用书库、检索和阅读进度。

scripts.check:data: node scripts/validate-data.mjs && node scripts/validate-library.mjs && node scripts/validate-knowledge.mjs && node scripts/validate-tang-study.mjs && node scripts/translation-coverage.mjs && node scripts/validate-poetry-context.mjs && node scripts/validate-song-study.mjs && node scripts/validate-daxue.mjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm test && npm run check:data && npm run build
scripts.format:check: prettier --check index.html assets scripts tests README.md DESIGN.md UX-CONTRACT.md playwright.config.mjs package.json premium-ui.json .github/workflows/pages.yml
scripts.build:translations: node scripts/build-prose-translations.mjs && node scripts/build-tang-study.mjs && node scripts/build-song-study.mjs && node scripts/build-daxue.mjs && node scripts/translation-coverage.mjs --write
